title: Discovery of the Immaculate Constellation briefing on a Pentagon classified system
place_text: Pentagon, OSD Under Secretary of Defense for Policy office

tellings.quote: Uh so immaculate constellation uh it's a or it was described to me at least in my limited exposure as a operational SAP governing the intelligence surveillance and reconnaissance of UAP um around the world using tasked and unts.

plain: A man named Matthew Brown, who says he worked in a Pentagon policy office, says that around 2018 he came across a briefing on a classified computer system about something called Immaculate Constellation. As it was described to him, it was a special access programme, a tightly restricted secret project, that ran the watching and tracking of UAP, the official term for UFOs, around the world, using sensors both aimed at them on purpose and picking them up by chance. If true, it would mean the military has been quietly collecting UFO sightings worldwide.
